title: Why PS5 Fans Are Leaving Sony for PC

scenes.text: Rumor has it, 45% of PS5 fans are considering a PC switch!
Users cite frustrations with PS5's limitations and high game prices.
Many believe a PC setup offers more flexibility and better graphics.
Understand the pros and cons before making the leap!
Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: Increasing numbers of PS5 fans are considering a switch to PC gaming. Follow for daily tech!
